title: Arquitetura do frontend
summary: Describes the prototype-phase (Fase 3) frontend architecture: stack, directory map, data layer (types/derive/operations/store/seed), routes, enforced UX patterns, language rules, and verification gates.
scope: Stack (React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, Zustand, Zod, Vitest)
Data layer: types per ontology region (primitives, workspace, structure, crm, ai, panels)
derive.ts (derived reads: effective lifecycle, effectiveListConfig, isOverdue, isBlocked, weightedValue, responseWindowOpenUntil, executionChainOf, marketingConsentMissing)
operations/ (OperationResult contract; tasks, deals, conversations, contacts, ai, members, activity)
store.ts (in-place mutation with revision counter, useData/useRun)
Transversal UX patterns as components (StateSeal, ConditionMarker, Button disabledReason, EmptyState, NoAccessState, RecordList)
Handoff to Fase 6 / Fase 5 visual decisions
notes: Manifest declared DOC (precedence 4). Content contains architectural decisions (in-place mutation + revision counter, OperationResult error-as-value, derive/operations boundary, readonly-as-invariant) and a stack table that could read as SPEC/ADR signals, but manifest is authoritative. Paths inside refer to the pre-monorepo layout (app/src/...); code has since moved to apps/web/src and packages/dominio/src, so file references are historical. References PRD I.4, PRD II.7 and ontology rule ids (A4.3, A4.4, B25, B58, B59, INV-CXE-04, RN-CXE-19, RN-CON-16, A6.2, INV-ET-12, B103, B38e, B79, B14, DO-NEG-05) without file paths.
